source: 2010 narrative review (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2853976/); FDA Campral medical review (https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2004/21-431_Campral_Medr_P1.pdf); Luo et al. 2015 (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26360834/)
notes: Two 333 mg calcium-salt delayed-release tablets provide 600 mg acamprosate parent equivalent. The review's 180 ng/mL value has no identified original arm; the FDA review reports approximately 94 ng/mL for a potentially different arm. The original Luo et al. fasted 244.64 ng/mL reference arm already contributes to a historical MMPK training aggregate, so it is not a fresh holdout replacement.

source: FDA label (Entereg); Capto et al., Clin Pharmacol 2007
notes: 12mg oral capsule. Cmax ~10.98 ng/mL from multiple-dose study. Very low bioavailability (6%). Single dose data limited; value from BID dosing to Day 5.

source: FDA label (Mepron); single 750mg dose fasted
notes: 750mg oral suspension fasted healthy volunteers. Cmax 8.8 +/- 3.7 mcg/mL. Food greatly increases absorption (Cmax 15.1 with food). mcg/mL = mg/L.

source: FDA label (Tembexa); PK study in healthy volunteers
notes: 100mg oral tablet. Cmax 251 ng/mL, AUCinf 1394 ng*h/mL. Oral bioavailability ~13%. Newer drug (FDA approved 2021 for smallpox).

source: FDA label (Entocort EC); single 9mg dose fasted healthy volunteers
notes: Entocort EC 9mg capsule (controlled ileal release, not true IR). Cmax 1.50 +/- 0.79 ng/mL fasted. Very low systemic bioavailability (~10%) due to high first-pass.

source: DailyMed Carbinoxamine Maleate tablets/solution label; https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda/fdaDrugXsl.cfm?setid=9d11b197-cfdc-4b9b-9935-2920ccb6e522
notes: Single 8 mg carbinoxamine maleate oral solution (5.717741 mg parent equivalent); approximate parent-plasma Cmax 24 ng/mL. Exact N and meal state unspecified.

source: FDA label (Ampyra); oral solution PK data
notes: 10mg oral solution (IR equivalent). Cmax 42.7 ng/mL at ~1.3h. Note: marketed as ER tablets (Cmax 17-22 ng/mL); IR solution value used for engine comparison.

source: Kasichayanula et al., Clin Pharmacokinet 2014; bioequivalence studies
notes: Superseded: 165 ng/mL was an approximate midpoint across other studies, not an exact observed arm. The scored 10 mg fasted N=14 arm is directly tabulated as geometric mean Cmax 136 ng/mL in Kasichayanula et al. 2011 Table 1 (clinical_pk.json:dapagliflozin).

source: Tiseo et al., Br J Clin Pharmacol 1998; FDA label (Aricept)
notes: 5mg single dose healthy volunteers. Cmax 7.7 +/- 1.2 ng/mL. Long half-life ~70h.

source: FDA label; etodolac 200mg capsule healthy volunteers
notes: 200mg single dose immediate-release capsule. Cmax 15.9 mcg/mL. >99% protein bound. Bioavailability ~100%.

source: Phase I study in healthy Chinese volunteers; FDA label (Fruzaqla)
notes: 5mg single dose healthy volunteers. Cmax 113 ng/mL at Tmax ~2h. Linear PK 1-6mg. t1/2 ~42h.

source: Swedish Medical Products Agency Hydroxyzine Orifarm SmPC sections 2 and 5.2; https://docetp.mpa.se/LMF/Hydroxyzine%20Orifarm%20film-coated%20tablet%20ENG%20SmPC_09001bee807a397d.pdf
notes: A 25 mg hydroxyzine dihydrochloride tablet corresponds to 20.928701 mg parent; the SmPC gives typical adult single-dose parent plasma Cmax 30 ng/mL but does not identify the exact numeric study arm or meal state. Simons et al. 1984 instead reported 72.5 ng/mL serum after 0.7 mg/kg (mean 39 mg).

source: FDA label (Toradol); Jung et al., Biopharm Drug Dispos 1988
notes: 10mg oral tablet single dose. Cmax ~0.8 mcg/mL at Tmax ~0.9h. Oral bioavailability 80-100%.

source: FDA label (Epivir); Moore et al., AAC 2012
notes: 150mg single dose. Geometric mean Cmax 1.40 mcg/mL. Rapidly absorbed, Tmax 0.5-1.5h. Bioavailability ~82%.

source: Estimated from 10mg dose data (Cmax 0.72 mcg/mL) with linear dose scaling; Li et al., Clin Drug Invest 2019
notes: Active metabolite teriflunomide measured. After leflunomide 10mg: Cmax 0.718 mcg/mL. Scaled x10 to 100mg loading dose assuming linear PK. Very long t1/2 (~2 weeks). Tmax 6-12h.

source: Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2024, Table 2; https://doi.org/10.1128/aac.01344-23
notes: 300 mg single oral dose, normal-hepatic-function matched controls (n=10). Geometric mean parent-plasma Cmax 23.4 ng/mL; median Tmax 4 h.

source: FDA label (Kaletra); co-administered with ritonavir 100mg
notes: 400mg lopinavir + 100mg ritonavir. Cmax 9.8 +/- 3.7 mcg/mL at steady state. Single-dose data without ritonavir not clinically available; lopinavir is never given alone. Value represents boosted formulation at steady state.

source: Hibma et al., Cancer Chemother Pharmacol 2022, Table 2; https://doi.org/10.1007/s00280-021-04368-1
notes: 100mg single oral dose in healthy participants. Geometric mean Cmax 501.3 ng/mL (CV 38%). Absolute bioavailability 81%. Tmax ~1.2h.

source: FDA label (Purinethol/Purixan); single 50mg dose fasted healthy adults
notes: 50mg single dose fasted healthy adults. Mean Cmax 69 ng/mL. Another formulation reported 93 ng/mL. Tmax ~0.75h. t1/2 ~1.3h.

source: Simulated fasted steady-state Cmax from population PK; bioequivalence data
notes: Single-dose fasted Cmax in healthy volunteers not well-characterized in available literature. Using estimated value from popPK model (steady-state Cmax ~1950-2120 ng/mL for 400mg BID fasted). Single dose would be lower (~1000 ng/mL). Tmax ~3h.

source: Estimated from CR 25mg data and dose-proportionality; FDA label (Paxil)
notes: Single-dose IR 20mg healthy volunteers. Estimated Cmax ~5 ng/mL. Paroxetine exhibits nonlinear PK; steady-state Cmax 6-14x higher than single dose. CR 25mg single dose Cmax = 7.08 ng/mL. Food increases Cmax 29%.

source: Netter et al., Clin Pharmacokinet 1987; Cuprimine DailyMed label; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3319347/
notes: 250 mg oral dose: approximate 1-2 mg/L peak range only. The former 1.5 mg/L midpoint is not an observed cohort Cmax; do not score it.

source: FDA label (Salagen); multiple-dose PK study in healthy male volunteers
notes: 5mg oral tablet. Cmax 15 ng/mL from multiple-dose study (last 6h dose). Tmax ~1.25h. Fasted Cmax at 10mg was 59 ng/mL.

source: Narasimhan et al., J Clin Pharm Ther 2013;38:440-444, DOI 10.1111/jcpt.12082; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23888935/
notes: 45 mg single dose, fasted healthy subjects. Geometric mean parent-plasma Cmax 54.7 ng/mL. The FDA label's 73 ng/mL is a different steady-state patient arm. This 54.7 ng/mL arm also contributes to an MMPK training aggregate.

source: Krishna et al., Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2009;53:958-966, DOI 10.1128/AAC.01034-08, Table 2 Part 1; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2650585/
notes: 400 mg oral suspension, single dose after 10 h fast, without acidic beverage or esomeprazole, healthy volunteers (n=12). Arithmetic mean parent-plasma Cmax 151 ng/mL (CV 58%). A separate Part 3 fasted arm reports 181 ng/mL.

source: Liang et al., BMC Pharmacol Toxicol 2014; healthy Chinese subjects
notes: Active metabolite R-138727 measured (parent is prodrug). 60mg loading dose. Cmax 631 ng/mL (CV 36%). Tmax 0.5h. t1/2 ~7.4h.

source: FDA label (Prometrium); postmenopausal women fasted
notes: Micronized progesterone (Prometrium) 100mg capsule. FDA label reports Cmax 17.3 ng/mL. Endogenous progesterone levels confound measurement. Tmax ~3h. Food enhances absorption 2x.

source: DailyMed QUALAQUIN label Section 12.3 Table 1; https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=1f66fba7-4026-4504-918d-4c88f2835cc0
notes: Single 648 mg quinine sulfate oral dose in 23 healthy subjects; Cmax 3.2 +/- 0.7 mcg/mL. Each 324 mg sulfate capsule equals 269 mg quinine free base, so model input is 538 mg parent. Meal state is unspecified. Table AUC0-12 is partial and is not a generic AUC target.

source: Li et al. 2020 Table 2; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7027461/
notes: Single 30 mg quizartinib dihydrochloride tablet (=26.5 mg parent) in 34 fasted healthy subjects; arithmetic mean parent-plasma Cmax 102.0 ng/mL. 99.3 ng/mL is the geometric mean.

source: FDA label (Rozerem); 16mg single dose in elderly subjects
notes: 16mg single dose (2x therapeutic dose). Mean Cmax 11.6 ng/mL (SD 13.8) in elderly. At 8mg in adults, Cmax would be ~5.8 ng/mL by linear scaling. Very high first-pass; bioavailability 1.8%. CV ~100%.

source: FDA label (Mycobutin); single 300mg dose 9 healthy adults
notes: 300mg single dose 9 healthy adult volunteers. Mean Cmax 375 +/- 267 ng/mL (range 141-1033). High variability. Tmax 3.3h. Absorption >53%.

source: Zhao et al., Br J Clin Pharmacol 2009; healthy Chinese subjects single 10mg fasted
notes: 10mg single dose fasted healthy subjects. Cmax 143.2 ng/mL (geometric mean). Tmax ~2h. 10mg dose shows dose-proportional PK. Bioavailability 80-100% for 10mg.

source: FDA Zelapar NDA 21-479 clinical pharmacology review, study Z/SEL/96/008; https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2006/021479s000_ClinPharmR_P2.pdf
notes: Single 10 mg Eldepryl HCl (8.370430 mg parent) fasted in 12 healthy volunteers; mean parent-plasma Cmax 3.093 ng/mL. Previous approximately 1 ng/mL claim was untraceable.

source: Estimated from dose proportionality; Rapamune label; Brattstrom et al., Ther Drug Monit 2000
notes: 5mg single dose oral solution healthy volunteers. Dose-proportional PK confirmed. Estimated Cmax ~24 ng/mL from proportional scaling of available data. Whole blood measurement. t1/2 ~82h. Very high blood:plasma ratio (36:1).

source: FDA label (ella); single 30mg dose fasted healthy female volunteers
notes: Superseded: the ella 30 mg / 176 ng/mL arm administers and measures ulipristal acetate ester (C30H37NO4), not ulipristal (C28H35NO3). Corrected scored record is clinical_pk.json:ulipristal (historical split key).

source: Mohamed et al., Clin Pharmacol Drug Dev 2019, DOI 10.1002/cpdd.462, Table 1; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6585649/
notes: 15 mg extended-release single dose in 11 fasted healthy volunteers. Mean parent-plasma Cmax 26.0 ng/mL (SD 9.7). The label's 31.6 ng/mL is a different study arm.

source: Bioequivalence studies; FDA label (Effexor)
notes: 75mg single dose fasted healthy male volunteers. Cmax ~35.5-35.7 ng/mL (IR formulation). Bioavailability ~45%. t1/2 ~5h.

source: Sakurai et al., Clin Transl Gastroenterol 2015, Table 2; https://doi.org/10.1038/ctg.2015.18
notes: 20 mg single oral dose, Japanese healthy men (n=7): arithmetic mean parent-plasma Cmax 25.0 +/- 5.6 ng/mL. The UK arm is separate.
